propositions: Pandoc subprocess invocations can hang indefinitely on pathological input because pypandoc provides no timeout and subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child, not grandchildren spinning in pipe-holding processes.

The renderer must implement caller-side wall-clock timeout via proc.communicate(timeout=dc_pandoc_timeout_s) with start_new_session=True, and reap the whole process group via rebar._proc.reap_process_group on TimeoutExpired.
On timeout or non-zero exit, individual units degrade to their original Markdown without raising, preserving per-unit fallback semantics and byte-identical output to the landed renderer.
The pypandoc-binary wheel and bundled pandoc binary must be pinned by exact version in pyproject.toml, verified in CI, and recorded with GPL licence provenance in a new repo-root NOTICE file.
Safe-run batching optimization is descoped; spawn tax is addressed by the cutover story's change-gated rich_sha render gate instead.
